description: AI analyst personas — each is a structured prompt template the orchestrator can fire with concrete inputs.

personas.title: Stock Screener
personas.tagline: Top-10 picks with PE, growth, debt, moat, targets, risk rating.
personas.output: Equity research screening report + summary table

personas.title: DCF Valuation
personas.tagline: 5yr revenue / WACC / terminal value / sensitivity / verdict.
personas.output: IB valuation memo with tables & math

personas.title: Risk Assessment
personas.tagline: Correlation, concentration, tail-risk, hedging, rebalancing.

personas.title: Earnings Analyzer
personas.tagline: Beat/miss history, consensus, implied move, bull/bear cases.

personas.title: Portfolio Builder
personas.tagline: Allocation, core/satellite, ETF picks, drawdown, tax, IPS.
personas.output: Investment policy document with allocation pie

personas.title: Technical Analysis
personas.tagline: Trend, S/R, MAs, RSI/MACD/BB, patterns, entry/SL/TP.
personas.output: TA report card with trade plan summary

personas.title: Dividend Strategy
personas.tagline: 15-20 picks, safety score, payout ratio, DRIP compounding.
personas.output: Dividend portfolio blueprint with income table

personas.title: Competitive Analysis
personas.tagline: 5-7 competitors, moats, market share, SWOT, top pick.
personas.output: Competitive strategy deck summary with tables

personas.title: Pattern Finder
personas.tagline: Seasonal, day-of-week, insider, options, earnings reaction.
personas.output: Quant research memo with stat-edge summary

personas.title: Macro Impact Report
personas.tagline: Rates, inflation, GDP, USD, Fed, geopolitics, rotation.

personas.title: Strategy Generation
personas.tagline: 3 profitable strategies w/ indicators, entry/exit, SL/TP, edge.

personas.title: Backtester
personas.tagline: 5-10 yr CAGR, Sharpe, max DD, win-rate, regime sensitivity.

personas.title: Risk/Reward Analysis
personas.tagline: Per-trade risk, R:R, drawdowns + improvements.

personas.title: Market Regime Detection
personas.tagline: Trend / volatility / volume; best strategy + what to avoid.
personas.output: Regime call + go/no-go for each strategy family

personas.title: Multi-Factor Strategy
personas.tagline: Momentum + Value + Volatility + Trend with weights.

personas.title: Strategy Optimization
personas.tagline: Tune for Sharpe + DD; before/after comparison.

personas.title: Portfolio Construction
personas.tagline: Allocation %, expected return, volatility, drawdown.
personas.output: Portfolio table with reasoning per asset

personas.title: Trade Setup Generation
personas.tagline: 3 high-probability trades: entry/SL/TP/RR/reasoning.
personas.output: 3 trade cards ready for risk review

personas.title: Monte Carlo Simulation
personas.tagline: Probability of loss, return distribution, worst-case.

personas.title: Drawdown Analysis
personas.tagline: Max DD, recovery time, 3 ways to reduce.

personas.title: Macro-Based Strategy
personas.tagline: Rates/inflation/growth-driven entry/exit signals.

personas.title: Alpha / Edge Detection
personas.tagline: Behavioral inefficiencies + market-structure gaps.
